title: SAML 2.0 federation import + metadata attestation assistant and operator guardrails
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a guided SAML federation import assistant that performs strong metadata attestation, surfaces operator guardrails, and ties changes into RBAC v2 and audit logging. This ticket covers the import API, attestation heuristics, dry-run mode, UI assistant flows, telemetry, and an operator safety net (canary import and rollback). The assistant accepts metadata by URL or file upload, validates signatures and certificate chains, warns about risky assertions (e.g., broad AttributeStatements, wildcard entityIDs), generates recommended RBAC mappings, and records immutable audit entries for every step. The backend verifier will run in an isolated service and publish structured validation results to the console for admin review.
acceptance_criteria: Import assistant accepts metadata via URL and file upload and returns structured validation results
Cryptographic checks: XML signature verification, certificate chain validation, and expiry checks pass for valid providers
Heuristic checks: uniqueness of entityID, presence of required endpoints (AssertionConsumerService, SingleLogout), risky attribute mappings flagged
Dry-run mode applies validations and recommendations without changing customer config
Audit log entries created for import attempts, acceptances, rejections, and rollbacks with actor, timestamp, and validated fingerprint
Suggested RBAC mapping templates are generated and editable by admins
End-to-end tests + integration tests added and passing in CI, and GH PRs merged
Feature gated behind admin permission (RBAC v2) and feature flag for canary rollout
notes_and_decisions: Decision: perform attestation at import time and schedule periodic background re-validation every 24 hours for active connectors
Library choice: evaluate goxmldsig vs xmlsec (Python) for robustness; initial implementation will use the Go sig lib to keep runtime in the verifier service (see trade-offs below)
Storage decision: keep original metadata blob in encrypted object store but do not persist private keys; store a KMS-wrapped SHA256 fingerprint for change detection
Telemetry: emit structured events for each validation step to support regression alerts in Optimize
Rollback model: support operator-initiated revert to last known-good metadata snapshot with clear audit trail and opt-out grace period

Trade-off: doing heavy chain-of-trust checks for every import will increase latency; mitigate with async background verification for non-blocking UX while ensuring minimal synchronous checks for safe defaults
